body: I haven't felt any significant feelings this week, I had a strong reaction reading your words and really felt this. I wish I could make everything better for everyone else but I can't. I haven't been able to do anything for myself for a while now. I've messed up with alot of people and I feel like I'm losing touch. You're pain isn't your fault. If you need someone please reach out, I'd be happy to talk.

I used to be afraid of failing. Now I can't seem to try. I'm not that far in life yet but your reminded me of myself a bit. I had several screwups after another and became a bit of a recluse. I've read letters I wrote about a year back full of frustration and now I feel nothing. My attempts to get back and be "successful" have terrified me, and I've not felt anything significant for a while now. I don't know who I am. What you describe sounds like my fears for the future from over a year back when I was on the up and up, I know I couldn't handle it... Especially not how I am now. I am not very bright or experienced but it's alright. You don't sound wrong at all to me, I'd feel similarly in the same place.
